Summary: Paul's mutual-submission command: submit yourselves one to another in the fear of God — the heading under which the household code itself is given.
Commandment: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
Application: Distinct from the household row (live), which spells out wives, husbands, children, parents, servants, and masters: this is the mutual posture that precedes and frames all of them, owed by every believer to every other.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to make deference mutual in the body, not a one-way duty of the weaker party.
